div.div: سُجُومٌ : see سَجْمٌ. [As it is originally an inf. n., used as an epithet,] you say also أَعْيُنٌ سُجُومٌ Eyes shedding tears in drops, or simply shedding tears, or pouring forth tears; i. q. سَوَاجِمٌ [pl. of ↓ سَاجِمَةٌ fem. of ↓ سَاجِمٌ , of which last, accord. to Freytag, سُجُمٌ is a pl.]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
